title: feat(cli): os skills install, update and status at the server's version, with or without a project
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQ3DFv6XZAspQRYGQoEWhr8)_

Fixes #34773

Clause-②: yes (widening: a new published CLI command group, `os skills install | update | status`)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增 `os skills install / update / status` 三个命令，在有或没有项目的目录里，把已发布的 `@objectstack/skills` 按服务器版本装进 `.claude/skills/`，并能更新和核对；MCP 开放服务的安装提示改为这条命令。
- 为什么改：只连了 MCP 客户端的用户没有办法装技能，有项目的用户升级后也没有命令刷新技能，本地知识会悄悄落后于服务器。
- 风险与回滚：新增命令，不改已有命令；`update` 只动自己装过的技能，用户自己的技能目录从不触碰；回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/utils/skills-command.ts`（拒绝条件与写入顺序）、`packages/cli/src/utils/skills-install-state.ts`（`planSkillsWrite` 的归属判断）、`packages/cli/src/utils/skills-catalog.ts`（`npm pack` 读取与 tar 解包）。
- 两分钟验证：在空目录运行 `node packages/cli/bin/run.js skills install --version 18.5.0`，预期装入 11 个技能并写出 `.claude/skills/.objectstack-skills.json`；再运行 `skills status --version 18.6.0 --check`，预期退出码 1 并提示版本不一致。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`os skills install`** copies the published `@objectstack/skills` catalog at one version into the agent's skills directory (`.claude/skills/` under the current directory, `--dir` overrides). It works in an empty directory with no `package.json`, and in a project; it reads and writes no `package.json`.
  - Version, in order, and the output names which: `--version V` (exact; ranges and tags refused), else `--target T` (a target environment URL or a restriction profile file, read by the same `loadRestrictionProfile` as `os validate --target`, taking `versions.skills`), else the CLI's own version. `@objectstack/skills` and `@objectstack/cli` are in one `fixed` group of `.changeset/config.json`, so the CLI's version names the catalog written for it.
  - Source: the tarball at exactly that version, read with `npm pack` in the current directory, so the user's `.npmrc` files and `npm_config_*` variables (registry, scope mapping, credentials, proxy) apply; there was no existing registry helper to reuse. No third-party installer. The tarball is unpacked in process (`readTarGz`: ustar, prefix, pax `path`, GNU long name, checksum checked), and only `package/dist/skills/NAME/**` for each NAME holding a `SKILL.md` is kept. The tarball must declare `@objectstack/skills` at the requested version; a link, a path leaving the tree, or an empty catalog is refused. A version the registry does not publish is refused with a sentence naming it.
  - What was written is recorded in `.objectstack-skills.json` beside the skills: package, version, every file of every catalog skill with its SHA-256.
  - An existing recorded catalog is refused (names `os skills update`). A same-named directory the record does not name (for example one `skills experimental_sync` copied) is refused, naming it; `--force` replaces it ("adopted" in the output).
- **`os skills update`** moves the recorded catalog to the resolved version: replaces each recorded skill, removes recorded skills the new version dropped, adds new ones. A skill directory the record does not name is never written, replaced or removed: a new catalog skill whose name collides with one is refused even under `--force`. A recorded skill changed locally is refused, naming the files, unless `--force`. No record: refused, naming `os skills install`.
- **`os skills status`** reports installed versus expected version (same order), `missing`, `modified` (changed / removed / added files) and `extra` (directories the record does not name: listed, never judged). Mismatch = no record, another version, or any missing or modified skill. Exits 0; with `--check`, 1 on a mismatch. The registry is not read. All three commands take `--json` (one document on stdout).
- **`@objectstack/mcp`**: the open server's `initialize` skills install line now reads `... install that version into the agent's skills directory with the ObjectStack CLI, with or without a project: os skills install --version VERSION (where the CLI is not installed: npx -p @objectstack/cli@VERSION os skills install --version VERSION).` instead of `pnpm add -D @objectstack/skills@VERSION`, which needed a project. The README describes the new line. The #34686 line is not yet on npm (`@objectstack/mcp` 18.5.0 tarball carries no `Published skills` text, published 2026-11-15), so the pending #34686 changeset is corrected to name the new command (see DELIBERATE CORRECTION below) rather than this changeset declaring a same-release supersession.
- Registration: the `skills` topic in `packages/cli/package.json` `oclif.topics`.
- Docs: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` gains a `### Skills` section (all three commands, flags table); `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx` leads its install section with `os skills` for users with and without a project, keeps the `experimental_sync` path, and names `install --force` to move a synced project over; `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` describes the new install line and the MCP-only path.
- Changeset `.changeset/34773-os-skills-install.md`: `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/mcp` `patch` (Metadata-protocol `none` takes `patch`, per the Check Changeset level axis).

## Tests

- `packages/cli/test/skills-commands.test.ts` (unit tier), 22 tests. Seams: `skillsRegistry.fetchTarball` (the registry, answering tarballs the test builds or "not published") and `fetch` (the target's published restriction profile). No network.
  - Done when: in an empty directory with no `package.json`, `install --target URL` installs the server's version; after the server's profile moves to 18.6.0, `status --target URL --check --json` exits 1 with `installedVersion 18.5.0, expectedVersion 18.6.0, mismatch true`.
  - Install into an empty dir (files land, the catalog README does not, record names version and every file); `--dir`; version order (`--version`, target URL, target file, CLI fallback, and `--version` with `--target` refused); unknown version refused and nothing written; non-exact version refused before the registry is asked; install over a record refused; conflict refused then `--force` adopts.
  - Update: replaces, removes dropped, adds new, leaves `my-own` untouched; a new catalog skill colliding with a user directory refused even with `--force`; local edit refused unless `--force`; no record refused.
  - Status: match, version mismatch (0 by default, 1 with `--check`), missing/modified/extra with only missing and modified counting, nothing installed.
  - Tarball reader: long path via ustar prefix, other-version refusal, link and traversal refusal, empty catalog refusal.
- `packages/mcp/src/initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`: new case pins `os skills install --version OWN_VERSION`, the `npx -p @objectstack/cli@OWN_VERSION` form and no `pnpm add`. Red first against the old line, then green.

Nothing was written.`; `update --version 18.4.0` exit 0, then `status --check` exit 1, `The catalog is 18.4.0, not 18.5.0`.

## Review round (S1, S2, S3, N1)

- **S1, paths stay under the skills directory.** A tarball path segment, a recorded skill name and a recorded file path are refused when a segment is empty, `.`, `..`, or holds a backslash or a colon (`isSafePathSegment`, `skills-catalog.ts`). `applySkillsWrite` resolves every target (dropped skills, skill roots, files) and refuses any that does not lie strictly under the skills root, before the first write.
- **S2, malformed records are refused whole.** `readSkillsManifest` validates recorded skill names with the catalog's own `SKILL_NAME` rule and recorded file paths with the S1 segment rule, so an empty name can no longer make `update --force` remove the skills directory itself.
- **S3, Windows `npm pack`.** The invocation is built by `npmPackInvocation`; under `shell: true` (win32) the `--pack-destination` path is quoted, so a temp path with a space stays one argument.
- Red first: commit e5b66d7fc9 adds the pins and moves the invocation into `npmPackInvocation` with behaviour unchanged; `test/skills-commands.test.ts` then reads 5 failed / 25 passed: `refuses a Windows separator or a drive letter in a path segment`, `refuses a catalog file whose target resolves outside the skills directory, and writes nothing there`, `refuses a record naming a skill or a file with a Windows separator or a drive letter`, `on Windows runs through a shell and quotes the destination, so a path with a space stays one argument`, `a malformed record is refused whole > an empty skill name` (the `..` and backslash-name rows were already refused and stay as controls). Commit bbb4b559c7 fixes them: 30 passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION

`.changeset/34686-initialize-selection-rule.md` is a pending release note (not yet on npm: the `@objectstack/mcp` 18.5.0 tarball carries no `Published skills` text) that this PR makes false, so it is corrected here and `check-empty-changeset` stays red on it by design. Its install-line bullet now reads: "**The skills install line**: `Published skills: @objectstack/skills <version>` with the command that installs it into the agent's skills directory, with or without a project, `os skills install --version <version>`, at this package's own version (released together with `@objectstack/skills`), not the `version` option." The sentence in `.changeset/34773-os-skills-install.md` that said this PR supersedes the `pnpm add -D` wording in the same release is removed, since that wording no longer ships.

## Acceptance notes

- **"Active target".** `os validate --target` has no default target, so there is no implicit active target to reuse; the order is `--version`, `--target`, the CLI's version. Not invented here.
- **An open-source server does not publish its skills version over HTTP.** `RESTRICTION_PROFILE_ROUTE` (`/api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile`) is served by cloud only (its docblock in `restriction-profile.ts`), so `--target http://localhost:3000` against `os dev` is refused by the validate reader's own 404 sentence. For an open server the version reaches the user through the MCP `initialize` line, which now carries `--version VERSION`. Noted, not filed: it is the reader's existing behaviour.
- **`/mcp/skill` carries no install line.** The order said the install line rides `initialize` and `/mcp/skill`; on `a841e26b23` only `skillsInstallLine` in `mcp-server-runtime.ts` (the `initialize` text) carries it (`git grep "Published skills"`: one source hit). Only that one changed.
- The `skills-reference.mdx` page and `packages/skills/README.md` still document the `pnpm add -D` plus `experimental_sync` path, which keeps working; `skills.mdx` now leads with `os skills`. Left for the skills lane.
